text: 11月4日，沪深两市全天成交额合计20376.94亿元。其中，沪市成交额为9532.65亿元；深市成交额为10844.29亿元；创业板成交额为5493.30亿元。
text_en: On November 4, the total turnover of the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock markets amounted to 2,037.694 billion yuan. Among them, the Shanghai market turnover was 953.265 billion yuan; the Shenzhen market turnover was 1,084.429 billion yuan; and the ChiNext turnover was 549.330 billion yuan.
